name: Tippecanoe County 4-H
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club and do hands-on projects, including livestock and non-livestock projects. The county page also links to county fair entry and the Indiana State Fair.
grades: Grades 3 to 12 (Mini 4-H is grades K to 2)
who_can_apply: Youth in grades 3 to 12 can join a 4-H club in Indiana. Enroll through the Tippecanoe County Extension office.
pay_detail: $15 per child, $45 maximum per family. The fee covers insurance, project materials and club activities.
deadline_text: Enrollment for the Indiana 4-H year begins October 1. The county page asks members to enroll by Jan 15 (and says Jan 1 to keep traditional involvement). The drop/add deadline for projects is May 15 each year.
how_to_apply: Create a family account and enroll each youth in 4HOnline 2.0 (links are on the county enrollment page). Call the Extension office at 765-474-0793 with questions.
notes: The county page gives two enrollment dates (Jan 15 and Jan 1), so ask the office which one applies. The Extension office is at 1950 South 18th Street, Lafayette, IN 47905. This is a youth club, not a paid job.
